description: Selected financial indicators and sales-by-activity breakdowns from an Estonian entity's filed annual reports (RIK's monthly open-data extracts of e-Business Register annual reports) -- NOT full reports. Pass registry_code alone to list every year with a filed report (submission date, audited flag, filer-size category); add year for that year's figures: revenue, profit/loss, total assets, equity, average full-time-equivalent employee count, and sales revenue broken down by EMTAK activity area. Some filed reports carry metadata but no matching figures in RIK's extract (seen for some large/group filers) -- the report row still answers, with null figures.

year.description: Report year, e.g. "2024". Omit to list every year with a filed report.

name: ee_annual_report_stats
